title: FeedbackPatch
description: A validated text patch produced by feedback_applier for a writing/style/structural comment

feedback_id.description: Links back to the feedback_log entry

target_file.description: Relative path to the draft file, e.g. drafts/01_innovation.md

old_text.description: Exact string that must match the current draft content (used for Edit tool old_string)

rationale.description: One sentence explaining why this change addresses the comment

new_claim_ids.description: Any new CLM-xxx IDs introduced by this patch (must be registered in claim_registry.jsonl first)

new_source_ids.description: Any new SRC-xxx IDs introduced by this patch (must be in evidence_store.jsonl first)
